blocks.text: Jinglepod retains sound and play more readily than the whole occasion that once held them. Its loose beads give it an ordinary name. Cheerfulness is not a guarantee that the object suits every condition.
A lopsided jade ceramic rattle with a coral zigzag seam and loose golden beads trapped in its hollow center.
One-shot activation: The zigzag seam pops open and golden beads bounce upward once then settle. The game performs the final fade.

16 silver. Stress severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Happiness +12. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes. Drawback: existing Digestion gains 1 severity and 5 minutes. This does not create an absent condition.

Original PixelLab artwork and opening animation, October 28, 2026. Generation 78cb3edb-f2a5-4c7b-a1f4-e1ba64296bb8; animation 44b9330c-bc5e-4e4a-8417-15b9585dfeb8. The game performs the final fade; reduced motion holds a still.
